column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3669, items b and c): each test puts the real store behind the tenant and recovery routes on PostgreSQL and SQL Server and has no MySQL arm, because recovery keys come from provisioning, which refuses MySQL (D41). test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so each mssql subtest skips there and each postgres one runs: 2 skips, measured 2026-11-07 by running both tests with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set and reading the skip names. Both arms run, and pass, with both DSNs set.
